Kb.bar_b_note: The mossy-shell turtle material is close to the Mosshell board, but it barely tops the 1.80 m trainer, and neither side's faint reads clearly (A tumbles through a tipped roll, B just squats on its belly), so it falls short of Palworld finish.

Tv.bar_b_note: The cyan-and-coral serpent matches the Tidecoil board and towers over the trainer with a clear coiled silhouette, which is Palworld-class creature appeal.

Rs.bar_b_note: The otter-like water creature has a likeable silhouette, but its coat reads as one flat teal value (worst on B), and the faint end collapses into a featureless capsule.

Lz.bar_b_note: Same as Tv (the frames look identical): a saturated, readable serpent that matches Tidecoil, with a strong rearing silhouette at Palworld finish.

Qp.bar_b_note: Neither boar reaches the style bar: A wears an off-board gold leopard-spot coat and floats in faint mid, while B looks like a glossy terracotta piggy bank, and both stand no taller than the trainer.

Ek.bar_b_note: A polished, warm elder villager whose olive, moss and leather palette fits the Meadows key art; the big-eyed animated-film face is a little rounder than the naturalistic creatures but reads well at a glance.

Uw.bar_b_note: A's wolf is close to the Tanglevolt style bar and would carry it, but B's faint frames switch to a white-and-black default-looking material that breaks the creature's identity outright.

Ur.bar_b_note: B's blue-grey translucent panel is on direction, but the world behind it is a murky, low-value rainy night with a flat purple sky that has none of Palworld's brightness or Valheim's light shafts.

top_changes.change: Fix the creature faint states: stop Uw side B swapping to a white/black default material in faint mid/end, ground Qp side A's faint mid (the body hovers above a detached shadow), and give the Kb turtle and Rs otter faint ends a clear on-back or on-side resting read.

Re-material the off-style coats to the naturalistic style bar: Qp boar as matte brown bristle fur with moss (Mudsnout/Tuskroot board) instead of A's gold leopard spots and B's glossy clay look, and Rs as a matte coat with a darker back and lighter belly instead of flat uniform teal.
Scale the Qp boar and Kb turtle up so they clearly stand taller than the 1.80 m trainer, as the Tidecoil and Tanglevolt models already do.
